people.name: Athens
people.line: A major city in Greece, visited by Paul.

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
translations.bsb: While Paul was waiting for them in Athens, he was deeply disturbed in his spirit to see that the city was full of idols.
translations.kjv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
translations.asv: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he beheld the city full of idols.
